description: This Java source file defines the AdditionalUiSettingsFragment class, which manages the UI settings related to additional UI components and keyboard extensions in the AnySoftKeyboard app. It includes nested classes for browsing and applying keyboard add-ons for top and bottom rows, and handles user interactions with preferences and dialogs.

classes.name: AdditionalUiSettingsFragment
classes.description: Main fragment managing additional UI settings, including preferences for keyboard rows and UI tweaks, with nested classes for browsing and applying keyboard extensions.

classes.name: AdditionalUiSettingsFragment.RowAddOnBrowserFragment
classes.description: Abstract base class for browsing and applying keyboard extension add-ons for specific rows.

classes.name: AdditionalUiSettingsFragment.TopRowAddOnBrowserFragment
classes.description: Concrete implementation for browsing and applying top row keyboard extensions.

classes.name: AdditionalUiSettingsFragment.BottomRowAddOnBrowserFragment
classes.description: Concrete implementation for browsing and applying bottom row keyboard extensions.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up dialog controller and preference click listener.

methods.name: setupDialog
methods.description: Configures the dialog for selecting keyboard row modes and updates shared preferences based on user selection.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets activity title and initializes preference summaries and click listeners.

methods.name: onPreferenceClick
methods.description: Handles navigation to different fragments based on preference clicked.

methods.name: applyAddOnToDemoKeyboardView
methods.description: Applies a keyboard extension add-on to the demo keyboard view.

methods.name: loadKeyboardWithAddOn
methods.description: Abstract method to load a keyboard with a specific add-on, implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: getMarketSearchKeyword
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no specific market search keyword.

methods.name: getMarketSearchTitle
methods.description: Returns 0, placeholder for market search title.

methods.name: loadKeyboardWithAddOn
methods.description: Loads the keyboard with the specified add-on for top or bottom row.

methods.name: onTweaksOptionSelected
methods.description: Placeholder for handling tweaks option; calls super implementation.
